question: What happens to carelessness-born thought at the time of death?
premises: In embodied life, conceptual thought can arise from carelessness.
Such thought depends on embodied conditions.
At death, those conditions fall away.
inference: Therefore carelessness-born conceptual thought necessarily perishes at death, and supreme knowledge is realized.
uncertainties: The subject shift in the last clause is compressed; it likely refers to the knower realizing supreme knowledge.
plain_english: So conceptual thought that arises from carelessness while in the body necessarily perishes when the body falls, and then supreme knowledge is realized.
